title: International Institutions
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🇺🇳 International Institutions
blocks.intro: Global bodies created to manage international relations, trade, finance, and security.

blocks.heading: 1. The United Nations (UN)
bullets: Established on **24 October 1945** (UN Day) to replace the League of Nations. Headquarters in New York.
Six Principal Organs: **General Assembly:** Deciding body where all member states have equal votes.
**Security Council:** Responsible for international peace. Has 15 members: 5 Permanent (P5 with veto power: USA, UK, France, Russia, China) and 10 non-permanent members elected for 2-year terms.
**International Court of Justice (ICJ):** Judicial body. Located at **The Hague, Netherlands**.
**Secretariat:** Executive branch, led by the Secretary-General.
Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) and Trusteeship Council (suspended).

blocks.heading: 2. Financial & Trade Bodies
bullets: Bretton Woods Twins (1944): Created at the Bretton Woods Conference: - *International Monetary Fund (IMF):* Manages balance of payments and exchange rates. - *World Bank (IBRD):* Provides long-term development loans.
World Trade Organization (WTO): Established on **1 January 1995**, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). Regulates global trade.

formulas: UN Founded: Oct 24, 1945 | Bretton Woods (1944): IMF & World Bank | WTO: Jan 1, 1995 (replaced GATT)
